KeyTheme: Call to faithfulness and the coming messenger
Summary: Malachi, the last Old Testament prophet, confronts a discouraged post-exile people and their priests for half-hearted worship and broken covenants. He promises God will send a messenger before the great Day of the Lord.
Themes: Faithfulness; Worship; Tithing; Marriage covenant; Day of the Lord
Purpose: To call a complacent generation back to wholehearted devotion and to prepare them for God's coming messenger.
Outline: God's love affirmed (1); Priests and people rebuked (2); Robbing God and the Book of Remembrance (3); Day of the Lord (4)
HistoricalContext: Addressed to Jerusalem in the mid-5th century BC, a generation after the Temple was rebuilt, under Persian rule.
